latHint: Think a lone elephant that has wandered away from the herd.
pivHint: A RAKE is a long-handled tool for gathering fallen leaves. In old novels, a RAKE is also a charming, mischievous fellow of doubtful morals - a ______.
winText: Charming trouble. RAKE was the pivot - a leaf-gathering tool to a dashing ROGUE.
lossText: ROGUE - a charming, mischievous scoundrel. RAKE was the pivot: a RAKE gathers fallen leaves, but in old novels a RAKE is also a dashing, mischievous man, a ROGUE.
